cycles.method: Conservative V4 core-path bounds (16 cycles per ordinary instruction) from the native probe of the 0.2.2 source (evidence/probes.json, 3,563,628 executed cases; KEYHOLD adds three instructions to the SC_KEY frame path, and the probe now also checks a key hold kept after KEY moves away and released on unmute). Event: one pass of the frame hook, once per 16-sample block; at most 3,392 (SC_KEY variant, OTFX-T; 2,032 plain). The per-trig hooks are separate events of at most 352 each (fresh bind); all eight tracks triggering in one block add at most 13,184, which tests.qualification counts per block (16,576). 382 is the largest measured MCF5206E model path. Budget: one 362.8 us frame at 264 MHz. Not chip wall-clock timing.

load.method: No physical cfmeter.py stock/module interrupt and idle capture for 0.2.2; no model values substituted.
